'''Gallium''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that could be found on [[Altor 14]], a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]], [[Water/Legends|arid]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of sand and rocky [[Desert/Legends|wastes]]<ref name="GG4-2" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zoraster sector/Legends|Zoraster sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Roti-Ow system]]</ref> Deposits of gallium were present in territories controlled by communities of the [[Nuiwit]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] that, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], had developed [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. After relatively long negotiations following the discovery of Altor 14 by a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] from the [[Rego Mineral Company]] at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Nuiwit agreed to establish trade relations with the company for the purposes of mining gallium.<ref name="GG4-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gallium was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars]]'' in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook authored by [[Troy Denning]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Gallium|gallium]] is a [[Wikipedia:Chemical element|chemical element]] and [[Wikipedia:Metal|metal]] that liquefies at slightly above [[Wikipedia:Room temperature|room temperature]]. It largely does not occur either in free form or in the form of independent minerals but is rather extracted as a byproduct during the mining of other ores. Gallium is used in the manufacture of [[Wikipedia:Semiconductor|semiconductors]].<ref name="GalliumBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/gallium|text=Gallium &#124; Uses, Properties, & Facts|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2024-06-06|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20240510211559}}</ref>
